name: Bachelor of Education
overview: B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) is a specialized undergraduate degree that prepares individuals for a career in teaching and education. The program equips aspiring educators with knowledge of pedagogy, curriculum development, and educational psychology. This field shapes society by developing teachers who act as role models, mentors, and facilitators for student development. Education systems understanding and policy familiarity are essential for modern educators.

careerLadder: High school education with focus on English, social sciences, and relevant subjects
Undergraduate B.Ed program enrollment at reputable colleges
Active participation in teaching practicals and internships
Master's degree in Education (M.Ed) or specialized postgraduate programs
Standardized exams (GRE or country-specific entrance exams) for international opportunities
